segments.text: Mine? Well... [chuckle] it usually starts with a bad joke.
But tonight is different! This voice runs on one laptop. No cloud. No internet!
[sigh] And sometimes... it even gets a little emotional.
Wait. That's not his voice anymore.
أَنَا لَسْتُ هُوَ... أَنَا صَوْتُهُ الجَدِيد.
segments.caption: I'm not him... I'm his new voice.
